//Connection: How new members are admitted (ARCHITECTURE.md 5.2). Mode is one of:
Open           - anyone may register. The default.
PasswordGated  - a shared password is required to join. Existing members are unaffected
by a later change, since the password gates registration only.
AllowlistOnly  - only the public keys listed below may register.
JoinSecretHash is a HASH of the joining password, never the password itself. A
PasswordGated server with this unset admits nobody, which is the safe direction to fail.
Allowlist entries are base64url public keys - either a bare signing key or the full
shareable identity token a member sends you. Unreadable entries are ignored, not fatal.
In a container, override as Connection__Mode and Connection__JoinSecretHash.
